name: HasWeightNormLe.prod
summary: Induction over the finite set s: the empty product is the polynomial of the vector of values at 0 of the weight-0 basis, and a product with one more factor is again the polynomial of a vector, with the norm bound of the Cartan product.

steps.claim: Induction on the finite set s (Finset.induction_on).
steps.lean:
s.induction_on (by simpa using ⟨weylEval _
  _ 0, by simp [weylKernel, highestPoly, tableauPoly, weylNormSq, PolyRep.star_weylEval]⟩) <| by
  simp_intro _ _ _ i; apply_rw [i]
  exact fun ⟨_, e⟩ ⟨_, f⟩ ↦ e.1 ▸ f.1 ▸ (range_toPoly.ge (by simp [SetLike.mul_mem_graded,
    diagramWeight_add, nablaFam, ← range_toPoly])).imp fun _ z ↦
    ⟨z, by grind [(weylNormSq_le_mul_of_toPoly_eq z).trans, weylNormSq_nonneg, mul_le_mul]⟩

steps.claim: Case s = ∅: the claim is HasWeightNormLe p 0 1 1. The witness is the vector weylEval of the values at 0 of the basis polynomials of weight 0; by the definitions of weylKernel, highestPoly, tableauPoly and weylNormSq its polynomial is the constant 1 and its squared norm is at most 1.
steps.lean:
(by simpa using ⟨weylEval _
  _ 0, by simp [weylKernel, highestPoly, tableauPoly, weylNormSq, PolyRep.star_weylEval]⟩)

steps.claim: Case s' = insert i s with i ∉ s: we prove the claim for s' from the claim for s (the induction hypothesis), assuming the hypothesis for every member of s'.
steps.lean:
<| by
  simp_intro _ _ _ i; apply_rw [i]
  exact fun ⟨_, e⟩ ⟨_, f⟩ ↦ e.1 ▸ f.1 ▸ (range_toPoly.ge (by simp [SetLike.mul_mem_graded,
    diagramWeight_add, nablaFam, ← range_toPoly])).imp fun _ z ↦
    ⟨z, by grind [(weylNormSq_le_mul_of_toPoly_eq z).trans, weylNormSq_nonneg, mul_le_mul]⟩

steps.claim: Introduce i ∉ s and the hypotheses; the sum of the weights over insert i s is κ i + Σ_s κ, the product of the polynomials is F i · ∏_s F, and the product of the bounds is b i · ∏_s b; the hypothesis for the members of s gives, through the induction hypothesis, a witness for s.

Given witnesses ξ_i of F i and ξ_s of ∏_s F, the product F i · ∏_s F lies in the module of semi-invariant polynomials of weight κ i + Σ_s κ (graded multiplication, diagramWeight_add), which is the range of toPoly; so it is toPoly of a vector z, and if p holds then weylNormSq z ≤ weylNormSq ξ_i · weylNormSq ξ_s ≤ b i · ∏_s b by the submultiplicativity weylNormSq_le_mul_of_toPoly_eq, nonnegativity of the norms and monotonicity of multiplication.
steps.lean:
exact fun ⟨_, e⟩ ⟨_, f⟩ ↦ e.1 ▸ f.1 ▸ (range_toPoly.ge (by simp [SetLike.mul_mem_graded,
    diagramWeight_add, nablaFam, ← range_toPoly])).imp fun _ z ↦
    ⟨z, by grind [(weylNormSq_le_mul_of_toPoly_eq z).trans, weylNormSq_nonneg, mul_le_mul]⟩
